title: If the master, owner or agent of [3][a special
text:
84. If the master, owner or agent of [a special

trade passenger] or pilgrim ship, after
having obtained any of the certificates
mentioned in Part VIII, fraudulently does or
suffers to be done anything whereby the
certificate becomes inapplicable to the
altered state of the ship, or [special trade
passengers] or pilgrims or other matters to
which the certificate relates.
